indicator_definitions.obv_rising_5: OBV close minus OBV 5 bars earlier > 0; 5m CLOSED candles
indicator_definitions.indicator_change_over_5m: after next closed 5m bar minus value at entry signal
indicator_definitions.best_coin_comparison_after_5m: ex-post only, 7 assets x 2 hypothetical directions

notes: Hypothetical entry at signal candle close; no spread or slippage. 1m candles resolve first-touch order when possible; both within one minute remain unknown.

sma10_20_rules.entry: SMA10/SMA20 cross on CLOSED 5m candle; no ADX entry filter
sma10_20_rules.take_profit: 1% favorable PRICE move before fees, broker trigger intrabar
sma10_20_rules.stop_loss: LONG: 1% below live SMA10; SHORT: 1% above live SMA10, solved for live price using previous 9 closed candles
sma10_20_rules.broker_stop_loss: Native BloFin SL triggers intrabar; tighten only every 5m: LONG moves up, SHORT moves down, never backwards
sma10_20_rules.legacy_position_policy: Older opposite-cross SMA positions keep broker SL -1%, opposite RSI14/SMA14 exit, opposite SMA10/SMA20 exit
sma10_20_rules.other_exit: NEW: one-way SMA10 +/-1% trailing broker SL or TP +1% only

best_coin_comparison_after_5m.interpretation: Hindsight only: entry at 5m signal candle CLOSE; exit after exactly one next 5m candle CLOSE with assumed 0.12% round-trip fees. Not actual fills, not a usable advance selection rule.
